summary: Euroseas Ltd. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing a 3-year charter contract extension for its 2007-built feeder containership, EM Kea. The extension runs 36-38 months at $30,000/day, a ~60% increase from the prior $19,000/day, starting July 14, 2026. This is a routine commercial contract renewal, not a special situation, as it involves no acquisition, divestiture, tender, or structural corporate change. The filing is a foreign private issuer report providing standard operational updates and charter coverage metrics, with no board recommendation or advisor named. No risk-arb angle exists; the event simply reflects ongoing fleet management.
